name: Meifeng Wu
source: Dr. Meifeng Wu is the head of the Health Sciences and Biology Department. She has somewhat of an eccentric sense of humor... but deeply cares about her students and yearns to be a good mentor to them. Dr. Wu is an accomplished retired surgeon and has researched multiple topics in the health sciences before teaching at Arlington.
